name: zhihu/web/scholar-search-v3
description: Search Zhihu Scholar papers matching specified keywords and filters. Returns paper details including IDs, titles, highlight snippets, and Zhihu paper URLs.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Zhihu Scholar Paper Search API Searches Zhihu Scholar for academic papers that match a keyword. It needs one input, `keyword`, and returns a page of papers with titles, authors, journal, keywords, and highlighted snippets. ## Use cases - Build a reading list of papers that mention a company or topic, such as `OpenAI`. - Collect author names and journal names to see who publishes on a subject. - Scan the `` highlight snippets to check how a keyword appears in each title and abstract. - Page through results to build a paper dataset for a keyword. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/scholar-search-v3" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search Keywords | | `advanced_filter` | string | No | | | `classification` | string | No | | | `indexed_by` | string | No | | | `limit` | string | No | Number of papers per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_params": "sb_vip_xunzhi=1;sb_sku_ui=1;sb_slot_domain=2;dm_search_pregen=1;dm_ai_corner1=0;…", "data": [ { "highlight": { "excerpt": "intelligence(AI)tool was developed using the OpenAI—Application Program…", "title": "Automation of Software Development Stages with the OpenAI API" }, "hit_labels": null, "id": "2014571995023581630", "index": 0, "object": { "attached_info_bytes": "Ov8BCgtwbGFjZWhvbGRlchIgNWVkYzhhNWU2MjZjNTU4YmUwM2ZmZjhlYmNmN2E4MDkYhQEiEzIwMTQ1…", "authors": [ "Verónica C.Tapia" ], "excerpt": "In recent years,automation has become a key focus in software development as org…", "id": "2014571995023581630", "journal": "Computer Systems Science & Engineering", "journal_volume": "49", "keywords": [ "Artificial intelligence tools" ], "period": "1" }, "type": "search_result" } ], "domain_info": { "first_category": "" }, "filter_items": null, "hit_labels": null, "is_brand_word": false, "is_koc_words": false, "item_in_view": [ { "index": 5, "token": "b62a7302…", "type": "user_survey" } ], "paging": { "is_end": false, "next": "https://api.zhihu.com/search_v3?advert_count=0&correction=1&filter_fields=%7B%27…" }, "pendant": null, "related_search_result": [], "search_action_info": { "attached_info_bytes": "OqQBEiA1ZWRjOGE1ZTYyNmM1NThiZTAzZmZmOGViY2Y3YTgwOUoGb3BlbmFpUABYGWABagZPcGVuQUlw…", "isfeed": false, "lc_idx": 10, "search_hash_id": "5edc8a5e626c558be03fff8ebcf7a809" } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].id` | ID of the search result. It matches the paper ID in `data[].object.id`. | | `data[].highlight.title` | Paper title with each keyword match wrapped in `` tags. | | `data[].highlight.excerpt` | Snippet of the abstract around the match, with `` tags on the keyword. | | `data[].object.authors[]` | List of author names for the paper. | | `data[].object.journal / data[].object.journal_volume / data[].object.period` | Journal name, volume, and issue number (`period`) of the paper. `journal_volume` is missing on some items. | | `data[].object.keywords[]` | Keywords the paper lists for itself. | | `data[].object.excerpt` | Plain-text abstract excerpt with no highlight tags. It is cut short. | | `data[].object.title` | Plain title without highlight tags. It appears on some items only. | | `paging.is_end` | `false` when more results are available. Use it to decide whether to request another page. | | `paging.next` | URL for the next page of results. | ## Notes - Set `keyword` to the search term. `limit` sets the page size and `offset` sets where the page starts. Both are strings. - Keep reading pages until `paging.is_end` is `true`. - Paper IDs are long numeric strings. Treat them as strings, not numbers. - To search other Zhihu content, try [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3) or [Zhihu Ebook Search](/apis/zhihu/web/ebook-search-v3). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
